summary: The game's sound triggers. In a client script it plays, stops and adjusts them on this machine only, with nothing sent to others: each call returns whether the game accepted it, false before a world has loaded, for a name the game's audio data does not have, and for an entity that is not there. In a server script, playAt and playFrom play one for every player near a point or a body, and list names the game's triggers. The game's cinematic triggers (cin_*) play without an error outside their scene but are not heard, because their sound bank loads only with the scene.

list.summary: Server only. The game's sound trigger names (from its Libs/GameAudio files), sorted, optionally only those starting with `prefix`, as Vfx.list names effects. The cinematics' triggers (cin_*) are left out: outside their scene they are not heard.

params.prefix: Optional: only names starting with it, such as 'a_o_bell'.

list.exampleLua:
for _, bell in ipairs(kcds.world.Audio.list("a_o_bell")) do
  print(bell)
end

play.summary: Plays a trigger at the local player.

playAt.summary: Plays a trigger as a free sound at a point for every player within `range` of it, in its dimension, whose client scripts run. The sound is told once: a player who comes near later does not hear it. Returns whether any player was told.

params.options: Optional: `range`, metres, more than 0 and at most 200, default 30; `dimension`, by default the shared one.

playAt.exampleLua:
local Audio = kcds.world.Audio
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

-- The church bell for everyone within 150 m.
Audio.playAt("a_o_bell_kkut_kostelni", Vector3.new(1530, 2125, 30), { range = 150 })
playAt.exampleCs:
// The church bell for everyone within 150 m.
Audio.PlayAt("a_o_bell_kkut_kostelni", new Vector3(1530, 2125, 30), new { range = 150 });

loopAt.summary: Keeps a trigger playing at a point in the world until stopLoop, for an ambience, a fire or bees that should go on. Returns the loop's number, or 0 when the game did not play it. Leaving the world stops every kept sound.

params.trigger: The trigger name, such as one of the game's world loops (a_l_village_amb01).

loopAt.exampleLua:
local Audio = kcds.world.Audio
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

local pond = Audio.loopAt("a_l_amb_small_pond", Vector3.new(1530, 2125, 14))
if pond == 0 then
  print("the pond sound did not start")
end

stopLoop.summary: Stops a sound loopAt keeps playing. Returns false for a number that is not playing.
stopLoop.exampleLua:
local Audio = kcds.world.Audio
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

local fire = Audio.loopAt("a_l_fire_torch", Vector3.new(1530, 2125, 15))
setTimeout(function()
  Audio.stopLoop(fire)
end, 60000)

playFrom.summary: Plays a trigger from an entity's body, so it moves with it, for every player within `range` of it, in its dimension, whose client scripts run. A game without that body plays it where the entity was. Returns whether any player was told.

params.entity: A Player, an Npc, a Horse or its network id.
params.options: Optional: `range`, metres, more than 0 and at most 200, default 30.

playFrom.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerCommand", function(player, command)
  if command == "whistle" then
    kcds.world.Audio.playFrom("v_horse_whistle", player, { range = 60 })
  end
end)

playFile.summary: Plays a resource's .ogg file on an entity through one of the game's voice events.

params.file: A game path from the root, with forward slashes and no drive or parent folder.
params.purpose: How it sounds: 'inner' for an inner voice; '10', '20', '35', '50' (default), '100' or '200', heard up to that many metres; 'sfp_dialog', 'sfp_cutscene' or 'sfp_music'.

playFile.exampleCs:
// The resource ships stream/sounds/kcds/guards/halt.ogg.
Audio.PlayFile("sounds/kcds/guards/halt", guardId, "20");

stopFrom.summary: Stops one trigger playing on an entity.

silenceEntity.summary: Stops all sounds on an entity, including the game's own.

setSoundParameter.summary: Sets one of the game's audio parameters (an RTPC) on an entity.

setSoundSwitch.summary: Sets one of the game's audio switches on an entity.

triggerExists.summary: Whether the game's audio data has the trigger.
triggerExists.exampleLua:
if not kcds.world.Audio.triggerExists("v_horse_whistle") then
  print("this game has no horse whistle sound")
end

playAt.summary: Client only. Plays a trigger as a free sound at a point in the world, on this machine.

playFrom.summary: Client only. Plays a trigger on an entity, so it moves with it, on this machine.
